text:
QUOTE: "`ServerDataOperatorBase` (`handlers/index.ts`) holds the shared logic... and it extends `BaseDataOperator`" and "Shared by: every `this.batchRecords(...)` call in the handlers (for example `post.ts`, `thread.ts`, `group.ts`, `properties.ts`, `user.ts`, and the three product mixins)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says handlers call the inherited `batchRecords`. It never says each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase, which is the reason all writes share it. It also says some writes bypass `batchRecords`, which contradicts "every handler's writes."
